adjudication.notes: Drawn with every sweep queue passed, which is the accounting the two earlier 2.28.0 draws got wrong: they were given one queue file, so 704 already-read events counted as unread. A review flagged the drop from 1358 to 644 swept and hypothesised the quote matcher forgetting events; the cause was the invocation. Re-run with all 18 queues: 1348 swept, in line with the 1358 of the round before. The earlier draws were the CONSERVATIVE error — a larger unread population under the same sample — so no published bound was ever loosened by it. Zero sense errors here; the one finding was recall, the Portuguese name of the Fundamental Law of Active Management, added by amendment 39.
